tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures will not be acceptable.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.
EMD should be submitted as per kpp portal conditions

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments will not be responsible for non-accessibility of kpp portal due to internet connectivity issues and other technical glitches at bidders end
The tender processing fee will not be refundable
The tenderer should quote the rates including GST

The goods supplied shall be guaranteed for satisfactory performance for a period of 36 months from the date of supply. In case the goods are found defective during the above guarantee period, the supplier shall replace the goods at the cost of supplier at site otherwise security deposit will be forfeited

The total number of Farm Machinery Equipments as per the contract should be supplied respectively within 30 days from the date of Supply Order to the scheduled delivery destination as per Section-V of the this Bid Document
The goods offered for supply must be as per specification

The successful Tenderer should deliver to the employer a Security Deposit in the form of FDR/e-Bank guarantee (Any Nationalised bank)as per government circular No:FD5/expenditure-12/2023 Dt:15.05.2023 in favour of the Administrator, CADA, CBP, Mysore for an amount equivalent to 5percent of the Contract price and plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in the form of DD/FDR in favour of the Administrator, CADA, CBP, Mysore within 07 days in receipt of Letter of Acceptance in accordance with the conditions of contract at the time of agreement
All original documents should be scanned and uploaded and must submit at the time of Technical Evaluation if not the Tender will be Rejected
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will not be responsible and liable for those costs

The tenderers are requested to abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender Documents K/G-2 and further orders there on If the tenderer fails to supply the required Farm Machinery/Equipments within the stipulated period, the Security Deposit will be forfeited
The Authority has right to accept or reject or postpone any or all of the tenders without assigning any reasons

In the case of death of the contractor after executing the agreement/supply of equipments, his legal heir, if he/she is an eligible qualified registered contractor and is willing to supply the equipments at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work
Corrigendum will be published in the KPP Portal website only for any modifications and corrections.
Addendum will be published in the website for all modifications or corrections, if any
For any legal remedies, the courts at Mysuru shall only have jurisdiction
Typographical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the contractor
Other Conditions will be as per tender document
Special Conditions: Power Tiller must comply with TREM V emission norms certificate and upload the same
Special Conditions:The tenderer should be either Manufacturer or manufacturer s authorised entity or authorised dealers. Preference will be given to manufacturers authorised entity

Special Conditions:The Item Predominantly exists in the tender is for the supply of power tiller. If the success full tenderer is a manufacturer or Manufacturers authorised entity for power Tiller, then the tenderer should supply other three items such as Item No. (2) Tractor Mounted Rigid Cultivator, (3) Heavy Duty Hydraulic Tipping Tractor Trailer and (4) Tractor Operated Coconut Frond Chopper as per Specification and as directed by the Engineer-in- charge. If other tenderers participated are dealers for the Items No.2,3 & 4 separately or combined, will also be considered for those items. If they are successfull for Item No.2,3 & 4 separately, they will also be considered separately and the successfull tenderer will be offered

Special Conditions:Water Users Co-operative Societies (WUCS) under CADA has been spread in so many district of Cauvery Basin such as Mysuru, Hassan, Mandya, Chamrajanagar, Tumkuru & major taluk of their districts. The Manufacturer/Manufacturers authorised entity should have been established service centres at these location

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer has to established financial, technical, and production capability necessary To perform the Contract and meets the criteria outlined in the Qualification requirements specified in Section VII of KG-2 tender document For Manufacturer or Manufacturers authorised entity The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured or manufacturers authorised Entity who must have supplied the equipments similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80 percent of the Required Numbers for (1) Diesel operated power tiller having rated power not less than 13 HP at 2400rpm -52 Nos, (2) Tractor Mounted Rigid Cultivator (Non-Spring Loaded). 5 Heavy Duty Fixed Tynes -03 Nos (3) Heavy Duty Hydraulic Tipping Tractor Trailer of 5 tone payload Capacity-03 Nos and (4) Tractor Operated Coconut Frond Chopper Shredder, PTO driven, 35HP and above -03 Nos in any one of the last 3 years. i.e 2023-24 to 2025-26. The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after January 2026 and be in satisfactory operation for last 6 months as on date of tender opening

Tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized Dealers of a manufacturer, meeting with the requirement in full, can also be considered provided The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format (as per Section XIII) assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per GCC and SCC and The tenderer, as authorized dealer, has supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least 30 percent of the Required Numbers for (1) Diesel operated power tiller having rated power not less than 13 HP at 2400rpm -20 Nos, (2) Tractor Mounted Rigid Cultivator (Non Spring Loaded). 5 Heavy Duty Fixed Tynes -02 Nos (3) Heavy Duty Hydraulic Tipping Tractor Trailer of 5 tone payload Capacity-02 Nos and (4) Tractor Operated Coconut Frond Chopper Shredder, PTO driven, 35HP and above -02 Nos in any one of the last 3 preceding financial years i.e 2023-24 to 2025-26 years which must be in satisfactory operation for at least 12 months from the date of supplying
The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance in proforma under Section XII of KG-2 tender document

For Manufacturer or Manufacturers authorised entity The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be Rs. 155.16 lakhs during the the last 3 preceding financial years i.e 2023-24 to 2025-26
